title: analogRead: ADC, analog sensors, and voltage

spans.text: An ADC converts analog voltage to a number. `analogRead(A0)` returns a raw value; classic UNO commonly defaults to 0–1023, while ESP32 range depends on board/core configuration and is often 12-bit. A raw reading is not volts or temperature without range, reference voltage, and sensor calibration.

spans.caption: analogRead: ADC, analog sensors, and voltage

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: Never apply 5 V to an ESP32 ADC pin. Verify `analogReadResolution` and attenuation behavior for the selected board and core.
